messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: Selecting soil type as condition
parts:
Hi Edward,

For calibrating SWAT model, R-SWAT can modify any files in the TxtInOut folder
However, for calibrating the SWAT+ model, R-SWAT only create/modified the calibration.cal file

The calibration.cal file in SWAT+ does not allow specifying parameters by subbasins => landuse => soil type as in SWAT. It just allow filtering parameter per object and condition.
